description: This file contains a class 'CombinationChartRenderer' which is responsible for rendering combination charts in the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for initializing, laying out, drawing, and managing series of different chart types like area, column, and line within a combined chart.

classes.name: CombinationChartRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for combination charts, supporting various series types and their layout, formatting, and drawing.

methods.name: CombinationChartRenderer
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the renderer with specified parameters.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific info, including series, axes, legend, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout for axes, legend, and plot area, and formats series rendering.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the entire combination chart, including series, axes, legend, gridlines, and data labels.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes series rendering info objects for all series in the chart.

methods.name: DistributeSeries
methods.description: Distributes series into categories based on chart type (area, column, line) for specialized rendering.
